[[File:Borg_Construct_AJ6_Side_Schematic.png|thumb|right|250px|Side schematic of the Borg Construct Aj^6 showing the unit's Knowledge Cartridge Port.]]
A '''Knowledge Cartridge Port''' was a component installed on [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries']] [[AJ^6 cyborg construct/Legends|AJ^6 cyborg construct]]. The unit featured several ports that [[knowledge cartridge]]s could be loaded into, allowing the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] to assimilate information on specific procedures and subjects, allowing them to become instant experts.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
